Endpoint normalization is pure and deterministic: repeated/concurrent construction yields identical URL bytes without mutation; invalid roots fail before credential lookup.

items.resolution: Five real TCP fixtures in tests/openai_chat_conformance/lifetime.rs cover cancellation before headers for unary and streaming, unary body collection, streamed text, and incomplete tool arguments. Each observes upstream EOF, joins the backend task, and proves the held admission permit is reclaimed with a subsequent successful request within bounded deadlines. No claim is made about already-in-flight bytes.
Concurrent requests resolve only their configured provider key; no credential crosses request/provider boundaries or survives redirect refusal.

items.resolution: Reject negative, fractional, nonfinite and overflowing token counters/indices; preserve valid integral counts without wraparound or lossy float casts.
